BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Reeves, Fey, Goodman, and Appleton
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Modifying the definition of retail car rental for the purposes of chapter 82.08 RCW in order to create tax equity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying the definition of retail car rental for the purposes of chapter 82.08 RCW in order to create tax equity; and amending RCW 82.08.011.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 82.08.011 and 1992 c 194 s 2 are each amended to read as follows:Retail car rental—Definition.
BillSection.P: For purposes of this chapter, "retail car rental" means renting a, to a consumer, a:
(1) Rental car, as defined in RCW 46.04.465, to a consumer; or

(2) Any other passenger car, as defined in RCW 46.04.382, that the owner, as defined in RCW 46.04.380, offers for rental, without an operator, through a marketplace facilitator. A rental for periods exceeding thirty consecutive days is not a retail car rental under this subsection (2).

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective dates—1992 c 194: See note following RCW 46.04.466.
